messages:
maya: Quick debrief from this morning — we saw two correlated failures: a cloud metadata API spike that throttled auth calls, and the model-registry returning 503s during token refresh. impact: short-lived 502s for inference and failed deploys.

alex: Ack. I can take the cloud side (retry/backoff + circuit). Planning to push a config change to increase client-side backoff and add jitter. target: EOD Friday.

jihoon: I'll own model-registry mitigations: add a read-only mirror and degrade to cached model manifests when registry is unreachable. estimate: prototype by Tue next week.

maya: Thanks — can you both also add clear runbook steps for oncall? e.g., command to flip to read-only mirror, and a tag to route requests to fallback model versions.

alex: adding runbook items now. putting a basic command snippet in the runbook:
```
# force-backoff-mode
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/api/clients/reload-backoff -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY"
```
Should be reversible.

tara: SRE asked for an immediate short-term mitigation: reduce client parallelism for metadata calls and add 429 handling on the service edge. I can take the 429 handler and a quick circuit flag. timeline: 24h.

jihoon: For the registry mirror, I propose a lightweight S3-backed manifest cache + periodic warm-up. Also need a TTL bump for model tokens; current 60s TTL caused storms during failover. Suggest 300s with jitter.

sre-lead: Good call on TTL. Also add an alert that triggers when token refresh errors > 5% p95. That will give earlier visibility.

incident-bot: Runbook created — https://internal.redwood/runbooks/outage-debrief-2683456789 (assigned to alex, jihoon, tara) :white_check_mark:

maya: Action items recap (please update with PR links and when done):
- alex: client backoff + runbook command (EOD Fri)
- tara: 429 handler + edge circuit flag (24h)
- jihoon: registry read-only mirror prototype + token TTL bump (prototype Tue)
- sre-lead: alert threshold + dashboard panel (48h)

alex: I'll put a short RFC/PR today describing the backoff algorithm and a canary plan.

tara: I'll coordinate a brief drill with oncall tomorrow morning to exercise the runbook steps after I land the 429 handler.

jihoon: adding doc for mirror and the degradation policy. also want a retrospective note: vendor auth endpoint had a hidden rate limit — we should add contractual SLO checks and an escalation path with vendor support.

maya: Agreed — add vendor escalation contacts to the runbook and a quarterly verification task. I'll own vendor contact updates.

alex: one more: we should label affected services in incident tracker with dependency tags (cloud-metadata, model-registry, auth). I'll add those in the tracker.

maya: Great. Let's reconvene next Wed in the post-incident review slot with PR links and drill results. :spiral_calendar:

sre-lead: Noted — I'll add a recurring verification to the reliability board to watch for patterns across vendor outages (monthly).

maya: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks owners, drop a note here or ping me 1:1. :thumbsup:
